gootex_core_notes: v11: The live formatter no longer re-saves the document when nothing has changed, so the editor stops jumping/scrolling while you pause or position the cursor (it reformats only after an actual edit). To update: Extensions → Apps Script → Libraries → GooTeX_Core_Library → select version 11 → Save. v10: Tables tab is more compact — long table captions clamp to 6 lines (click a caption to expand) and the empty 'no details' line is gone when a table has no comments. In the left outline, a WorPT table is listed by its \input line (reliable even when the caption is only markup). To update: Extensions → Apps Script → Libraries → GooTeX_Core_Library → select version 10 → Save. v9: WorPT tables now appear in the sidebar Tables tab and the document outline (they live in custom environments the scan previously skipped). v8: WorPT tab — the 'preview' link now draws a live picture of your own table (click to view in an overlay) instead of opening a static screenshot. v7: Check System Status shows each Doc's hidden mark (and whether the template is marked); clearer message when GOOTEX_TEMPLATE_URL is not set. v6: gooTeX only works in Docs started from your group's template (copies of papers are refused).
gootex_thin_client_notes: Replace Code.gs and Config.gs in your thin client with the latest version from GitHub
